role_summary: Lead liaison bridging business stakeholders and technical teams to design and implement Customer 360 (C360) data management strategies and MDM solutions.
must_have_requirements: 10+ years of business analysis experience in data management or customer data projects
Expertise in requirements gathering, facilitation, and functional documentation
Direct experience with MDM platforms (Informatica, Profisee, or Stibo Systems)
Domain expertise in customer lifecycles, segmentation, and marketing technology stacks
Proven background in data profiling, quality assessment, and defining matching strategies
Strong technical literacy in data modeling, APIs, data integration, and cloud architecture (AWS)
nice_to_have_requirements: Master's degree in Business Administration or Information Systems
soft_skills_priority: Translating business needs to technical requirements

scoring_criteria.name: Data Management Experience
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Core competency for overseeing C360 and MDM initiatives.
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: Candidates without dedicated MDM platform exposure may struggle.

scoring_criteria.name: Stakeholder Management
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: 40% of the role involves facilitating workshops and achieving compromise.

scoring_criteria.name: Technical Translation
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Acts as the literal bridge between business users and engineers.
evidence_type_to_look_for: Translating functional needs to API/Architecture specs

scoring_criteria.name: Business Domain Depth
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Must understand marketing/sales workflows to create meaningful data definitions.

scoring_criteria.name: Communication & Documentation
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Ability to convert complex concepts into clear business output.

scoring_criteria.name: Data Governance/Quality
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Ensures C360 data is reliable and compliant (GDPR/CCPA).
evidence_type_to_look_for: Data cleansing, matching strategies, compliance audits

scoring_criteria.name: Consultative/Agile Mindset
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Aligns with the 'dynamic' culture and methodology requirements.

summary_focus: Highlight your tenure as a bridge between Business and IT in C360/MDM ecosystems.
do_not_overclaim: Avoid claiming deep coding skills (e.g., software engineering); focus on 'technical requirement translation' instead.

cover_letter_guidance.positioning: Emphasize your role as the catalyst for reliable data that drives marketing and sales decisions.
bridge_gaps_honestly: If lacking specific MDM vendor experience, emphasize exposure to similar data architecture projects and ability to learn new platforms.
